name: shell-progress
description: Shows the progress that scripts report through the shell-progress helpers.

stallMinutes.title: Minutes before a job shows as stalled
stallMinutes.description: A running job whose progress file has not changed for this many minutes shows as stalled.

notifyMinutes.title: Minutes before a finished job notifies
notifyMinutes.description: A job that ran at least this many minutes raises a system notification when it finishes. A failed job always does.
